basic_info.description: Located in the desirable Portola neighborhood, this 2-bedroom, 1-bath home features fresh interior and exterior paint. The living room boasts a charming wood burning brick fireplace, perfect for cozy night. Upgraded bathroom, double-pane windows, and a bonus room in the garage add comfort and versatility. Enjoy the convenience of an attached one-car garage and a spacious backyard, perfect for entertaining or gardening.    Just minutes from Highway 101 and 280 freeway entrance, this home is close to bus stops (#54, #44) and within blocks of grocery stores, shops, and restaurants on Silver and San Bruno Ave. Plus, enjoy nearby McLaren Park, the vibrant Alemany Farmers Market every Saturday, and the Portola Library and much more.
